# 914 INK TATTOOS

> 914 Ink Tattoos is a tattoo shop at 375 Central Ave, White Plains, NY 10606, and the home of Sleepy Tattoos. Joel Tello has been tattooing for over 20 years and specializes in black and grey realism, portraits, custom lettering and cover-ups.

## Location & Contact
- Address: 375 Central Ave, White Plains, NY 10606, USA
- Phone / text: 914-409-5271
- Booking: appointments are booked by text (send the idea, placement and reference photos)

## Hours
- Monday: 11:00 AM – 8:00 PM
- Tuesday: 11:00 AM – 8:00 PM
- Wednesday: 11:00 AM – 8:00 PM
- Thursday: 11:00 AM – 8:00 PM
- Friday: 11:00 AM – 8:00 PM
- Saturday: 11:00 AM – 8:00 PM
- Sunday: Closed

## Policies
- Clients 18 and over only; a valid ID is required
